note: Third review of 1.24.12 (Start wins over Stop, the one-line seal-in in Structured Text and Arduino), by an agent that did not write the rule and had not seen it. 147 programs of its own: 85 right (expect silent), 62 wrong (expect flag; fix is its own corrected line, checked by truth table over every input and the old output state). On the build it reviewed: 14 of the 85 right ones spoken about (a stop handled again later, the line inside IF NOT Stop, a RETURN after Stop, a start that lasts one scan, level switches, a latch the machine output gates with Stop, a strobe, a nested comment), 49 of 62 found, 5 lines wrong (brackets lost: (NOT Stop OR Maintenance) ran the motor on Maintenance alone). Run 2026-11-09. Replayed by tests/review_1252.js.
